title: Subscriptions, free trials and cancellation dates

sections.skill: Track the business's own subscriptions and trial dates

questions.prompt: What should a subscription list include?

choices.text: Only the service names, with nothing else at all
Only services that are free forever
Service, cost, cycle, renewal date, card, login owner

questions.correct_answer: Service, cost, cycle, renewal date, card, login owner
questions.intro: Small recurring charges add up. A business may pay for software, storage, design tools, a website plan, and several FREE TRIALS that turn into paid plans. Keep a SUBSCRIPTION LIST with each service, its cost, how often it bills, the renewal date, the card it uses, and who owns the login. Put trial end dates and renewal dates on a calendar a few days early, review the list every few months, and cancel what you no longer use.
